elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Subparagraph 4.10 warrants only that services will be “free from defects,” not that they will be performed professionally and workmanlike.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Subparagraph 4.10(i) warrants that supplied software will conform to its documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty lasts only ninety days following delivery.
The services warranty lasts only thirty days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The stated remedy includes “repair or replacement” of non-conforming software or services.
The stated remedy includes a refund of fees paid for the non-conforming software or services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No warranty of compliance with applicable laws is included.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No warranty concerning malicious code is included.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Subparagraph 4.10(i) warrants software conformance to documentation for ninety days following delivery.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: Subparagraph 4.10(ii) warrants services to be free from defects for thirty days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedy expressly includes repair or replacement.
The remedy expressly includes a refund of the fees paid.
